_comment: Second provider — Google DiffusionGemma served by vLLM on the host (W4A16 int4).
_policy: Chat/reasoning (tool-calling parses via gemma4 but is unreliable at W4A16 — see docs/diffusiongemma-testing.md verdict 2026-07-27; keep multi-step agent work on Ollama). Clients must NOT send temperature/min_p/seed/min_tokens/logit_bias — vLLM 400s on them for diffusion models. W4A16 (compressed-tensors, Marlin int4) verified on RTX 5000 Ada 2026-07-26: ~15GB weights leave ~13GB KV → 128k context. Mutually exclusive with Ollama on the GPU for now — use `gpu-switch diffusion` before testing. See docs/plan/2026-07-22-diffusiongemma-providers-rollout/ and docs/agent-research/2026-07-26-diffusiongemma-int4-quant-hunt/.
_bridge: baseUrl uses the Docker bridge 172.17.0.1 for devcontainers; the installer rewrites the host per environment via DIFFUSION_HOST.
